cookies). With the second factor on (plan D8), ``mfa`` asks for an authenticator code

SummaryOut.description:
Home's numbers (CR-10 to CR-14), all from live settings, so a changed allowance or
threshold shows on the next screen load.
SummaryOut.title: SummaryOut

post.description:
Sign in with Employee ID and password (CR-02). A wrong EID and a wrong password both
answer 401 ``credentials_invalid``; the fifth wrong password in a row answers 403
``account_locked`` with ``details.until`` (CR-07).
Step 3: choose a password and sign in. 422 ``password_weak`` (CR-05).

Step 1 of setup or reset: text a code to the number on file (CR-03, CR-06).
404 ``eid_unknown``, 409 ``no_phone_on_file``, 429 ``resend_too_soon``, 403
``code_locked``.

Step 2: the code. 401 ``code_invalid`` (with ``details.attempts_left``) or
``code_expired``; the fifth wrong code answers 403 ``code_locked`` (CR-04).

patch.description:
Change one or more settings by path (``allowance.crew``, ``tiers.silver.min``,
``badges.guest.bonus``, ``spin.prizes``...). Validated as a whole on the server: 422
``settings_invalid`` with ``details.fields`` mapping each path to what's wrong. Every
save is written to the audit log with the before and after values (NF-09).
